mapper.select: SELECT p.*, -- 사용자의 업종에 맞는 스크랩 수를 가져오고, 없으면 0으로 표시 COALESCE(psc.scrap_count, 0) AS bookmarkCount FROM policies p JOIN business_info bi ON bi.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN policy_scrap_counts psc ON p.policy_id = psc.policy_id AND bi.industry_id = psc.industry_id WHERE (p.region_id IS NULL OR p.region_id = bi.region_id) AND (p.industry_id IS NULL OR p.industry_id = bi.industry_id) ORDER BY bookmarkCount DESC, p.end_date DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO policies ( policy_id, user_type, policy_field, policy_name, policy_summary, department_name, supervising_organization_name, announcement_url, support_detail, selection_criteria, application_period, begin_date, end_date, notice_date, modification_date, application_method, contact, support_target ) VALUES ( #{policyId}, #{userType}, #{policyField}, #{policyName}, #{policySummary}, #{departmentName}, #{supervisingOrganizationName}, #{announcementUrl}, #{supportDetail}, #{selectionCriteria}, #{applicationPeriod}, #{beginDate}, #{endDate}, #{noticeDate}, #{modificationDate}, #{applicationMethod}, #{contact}, #{supportTarget} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_type = VALUES(user_type), policy_field = VALUES(policy_field), policy_name = VALUES(policy_name), policy_summary = VALUES(policy_summary), department_name = VALUES(department_name), announcement_url = VALUES(announcement_url), support_detail = VALUES(support_detail), selection_criteria = VALUES(selection_criteria), application_period = VALUES(application_period), begin_date = VALUES(begin_date), end_date = VALUES(end_date), notice_date = VALUES(notice_date), modification_date = VALUES(modification_date), application_method = VALUES(application_method), contact = VALUES(contact), support_target = VALUES(support_target)

SELECT d.document_name AS documentName, d.issuing_authority_url AS issuingUrl, (CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM user_documents ud WHERE ud.document_id = d.document_id AND ud.user_id = #{userId}) THEN '보유' ELSE '미보유' END) AS possessionStatus FROM documents d JOIN required_documents rd ON d.document_id = rd.document_id WHERE rd.policy_id = #{policyId}
